title: ControlSystems LQRGainSchedule

stats.done_summary: Successfully designed and verified a gain-scheduled LQR controller with anti-windup for actuator saturation at ±0.9. The controller uses linear interpolation of gains between 4 operating points (z=1,2,3,4). H-infinity norm verification confirms all norms are strictly below 1.0 (max: 0.9999). Simulation demonstrates stable closed-loop behavior with time-varying scheduling. All deliverables completed: analysis code, figures, and comprehensive report.
